module: Node "AI Directly To" (color ai, duration + once behavior). Makes a vehicle drive in a straight line to a target position, via an interpolated path sent to ai.startFollowing ("neverReset" mode). Inputs: flow, reset, vehId, target (vec3), targetVelocity (m/s, 1 by default). Output: flow, active when the vehicle has arrived. Data: minDistance (1.5 m), handBrakeWhenFinished, straightenWheelsWhenFinished, maxStepDistance (5 m).
notes: In setupAI, the loop goes from 1 to steps+3: the path overshoots the target by three points.
The local variable target is reassigned (target = target - origin), which creates a new object on each call.
The output flow pin is never reset to false once complete.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes started/complete and the default data.

reset.desc: Resets started/complete to false and calls endAI.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle of vehId, or the player's without input.

endAI.desc: Sends ai:scriptStop(handBrake, straightenWheels) to the vehicle according to the node data.

setupAI.desc: Builds a path of points spaced at most maxStepDistance apart between the vehicle position and the target (time = distance / speed) and sends it via ai.startFollowing.

work.desc: Handles reset; on the first flow runs setupAI; then tests the squared distance to the target and, below minDistance, stops the AI, marks complete and activates the flow output.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the Complete and Started states.
